name: CISA Tabletop Exercise Packages (CTEPs)
description: U.S. CISA freely available, customizable tabletop exercise packages covering ransomware attacks, ICS/SCADA intrusions, active shooter incidents, natural disasters, and other crisis scenarios. Organizations download and adapt packages to conduct structured discussions of crisis response procedures. Exercises guide participants through scenario injects requiring coordinated decision-making across organizational roles and boundaries.
reputation: De facto standard for organizational cyber and crisis preparedness exercises in the U.S.; adopted by thousands of public and private sector organizations
notes: Freely available at the CISA website. Covers a broad range of hazards beyond cyber, including physical security and natural disaster scenarios. Designed to be customizable to any organization's context and size.
